backendMode: LIVE — PROBEX_API_MODE=auto resolved to live against https://qubo-probex.duckdns.org/api
notes: The brief listed /dashboard/live-feed. The actual route is /dashboard/live — the nav label is 'Live Feed' but ROUTES.LIVE is '/live'. Captured at the real path.
The product consolidated 16 routes into 9 domain pages. Eight legacy routes still exist purely as redirects and render no UI of their own; they are listed as redirects, not captured as screens.
Domain pages carry tabs in the ?view= query param. Tab views that materially change the UI are captured as sub-routes.

captureLimitations.reason: The backend became fully unresponsive during the final capture window (60s timeouts, no response, on both /api/health and /api/markets), so no live market id could be obtained. Rather than fabricate one or skip the route, the composition was captured in explicitly-labelled MOCK mode. Treat the LAYOUT as accurate and the VALUES as synthetic.

backendConditionsDuringCapture.engineState: healthy but intermittently slow, then unresponsive near the end
observed: One /api/health probe measured 7.58s, exceeding the frontend 5s probe budget — this briefly resolved local dev to OFFLINE and required mode-verified retries.

Backend-side market data was itself stale throughout (api_access probe failing, "Market data stale (37461s old)"), so the DEGRADED header state and the Overview attention band are the engine REAL state, not staged.
In the final minutes the backend stopped responding entirely (60s, HTTP 000).
backendConditionsDuringCapture.consequence: Every screenshot had its runtime mode asserted at capture time; none was saved under a mode it was not actually in.
